operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install --non-interactive
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check && node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs verify-base --offline && pnpm integration:check
operations.recovery: Before leaving hosting, sign in as a Nook owner and open /export to download the native workspace archive, including database records and private file bytes. Keep it with the source and deployment snapshot. Restore with rer import into an empty stopped installation, then recover every retained identity before setup as documented at /docs/backups and OPERATIONS.md. Import rebuilds full-text search from messages. ChatHub holds derived connection frontiers and alarms, rebuilt on reconnect; live sockets, credentials and pending notifications are excluded. Verify messages, files and search before leaving.
